records.source: U.S. Naval Observatory, Earth Orientation Department, TAI-UTC table (tai-utc.dat), 1961 to the latest leap second: https://maia.usno.navy.mil/ser7/tai-utc.dat (SHA-256 3524e1ae34d67e858873a89e59983bbc5bd100221da898e796c1b36036a310c3); NASA JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility, NAIF generic leap-second kernel naif0012.tls: https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/generic_kernels/lsk/naif0012.tls (SHA-256 678e32bdb5a744117a467cd9601cd6b373f0e9bc9bbde1371d5eee39600a039b). records.variant: UTC as defined since 1961-01-01: 1961-1971 offsets with rate terms, integer leap seconds from 1972
records.conditions: TAI - UTC = offset_s + (MJD_UTC - mjd_reference) * rate_s_per_day from jd_utc_start; the 1972+ steps are cross-checked against NAIF DELTET/DELTA_AT at build time.
records.uncertainty: Exact by definition (IERS Bulletin C / BIH); valid until the next announced leap second.
